containers.name: probe
command: echo MINI_START; apk add --no-cache aws-cli >/tmp/a.log 2>&1; echo apk_rc=$?; echo "AWS_ROLE_ARN=${AWS_ROLE_ARN:-<none>}"; echo "AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=${AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE:-<none>}"; echo "AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-<none>}"; echo "AWS_STS_REGIONAL_ENDPOINTS=${AWS_STS_REGIONAL_ENDPOINTS:-<none>}"; aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; ls -l ${AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE:-/nonexistent} 2>&1; echo MINI_DONE
